description: Read the plain text of the terminal and every monitor, one entry per screen with its window number, peripheral name and lines. Cheaper than a screenshot when only the words matter; craftos_ui also gives colours, buttons and the cells to touch. delta:true gives a screen that has not changed since the previous read_terminal of this session as just {window, peripheral?, unchanged: true}.

delta.description: Return only what changed since the previous call.

fullScreens.description: Keep every line, trailing blank ones too (default: lines stop at the last non-blank one).

name: craftos_read_terminal
